diagnostic_a_T1.question: does the two-effect readout learn thematic role when DEPTH IS SWITCHED OFF? readout-soundness vs depth.

construction.twin_rule: yes-twin event (v, A, B); no-twin event (v, B, A); identical question 'did A v B'; bag-identical, answer flipped
construction.read: VAL accuracy ONLY -- doc 65 SS7.2 measured this family memorising 200 items to ~0.98 with the labels SCRAMBLED, so train accuracy is uninformative here

spectator_wires_are_inert.reading: purity 1.0 to machine precision = the spectator wires are in a product state with the rest, so the readout's partial trace over them contributes exactly 1 and they cannot carry signal. Kept so cast size and partial-trace structure mirror the real experiment.

descriptive_read.descriptive_bar: mean final val >= 0.60 under BOTH inits. Declared in source before the run. This is a READING AID, not a pre-registered criterion: doc 65 SS7.3 bars this block from the verdict.
descriptive_read.reading_key: A2 learns at T=1  => the two-effect readout CAN express thematic role; doc 65 SS7.2's failure is a DEPTH failure. A2 at chance at T=1 => the readout itself cannot express it at this design point, and depth is not the mechanism. A1 must be at exactly 0.5 (its blocks commute with SWAP, so the twins compile to the identical statevector); A1 above chance would mean THIS DIAGNOSTIC'S generator leaks.

checkpoints.why: exp40r_trainer.strip_state drops final_state and exp40r_arabic_diag writes only the stripped record, so no state_dict from that block exists on disk
checkpoints.reproduced: exp40r's H-honest condition (200 balanced train items from the exp41r train split, 60 epochs, lr 0.0050, batch 1, committed uniform init), states saved this time

sweep_construction.why_fresh_items: purity of a 2-wire marginal depends on how many wires it can entangle with, so K is held fixed and T is the only variable; and test_a/test_b/test_c are doc 22 SS7's gate sets, which a diagnostic must not touch

purity_invariance_under_question_inverse.claim: the question's inverse preparation is a unitary on the queried pair ALONE, so it cannot change that pair's purity; measured, not assumed
purity_invariance_under_question_inverse.bar_provenance: the simulator is complex64 (torch_sv_sim.CDTYPE) and exp76_run records a purity floor of ~1e-7 for it; 1e-5 is two decades above that floor and was declared in source before the run

diagnostic_b_purity_vs_T.reading_key: Tr rho_2^2 = 1 -> the queried pair reaches the readout PURE and every bit of role information that got there is available to the two effects. Tr rho_2^2 -> 0.25 -> the pair is maximally mixed and NO trained effect pair can recover the answer. A fall toward 0.25 with T, together with a T = 1 block that learns, INSTRUMENTS doc 65 SS7.2's depth mechanism instead of inferring it.
